<!DOCTYPE html>

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css" />
  
  <style>
    :root {
      --primary-color: #10b981;
      --secondary-color: #059669;
      --accent-color: #34d399;
      --text-primary: #1f2937;
      --text-secondary: #6b7280;
      --background-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
      --card-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
      --card-hover-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--background-gradient);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Animated background elements */
    body::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      top: -50%;
      left: -50%;
      width: 200%;
      height: 200%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
      animation: float 20s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    body::after {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      top: -30%;
      right: -30%;
      width: 160%;
      height: 160%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
      animation: float 25s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
      50% { transform: translate(-20px, -20px) rotate(180deg); }
    }

    /* Header styling */
    .header-section {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .header-section h1 {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--secondary-color));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .header-section p {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    /* Main container */
    .main-container {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 2rem 1rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .main-container .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* Form container */
    .form-container {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
      box-shadow: var(--card-shadow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      margin: 0 auto 2rem;
      max-width: 1000px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .form-container:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--card-hover-shadow);
    }

    /* Form sections */
    .form-section {
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      padding: 2rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    /* Ensure consistent spacing for all form sections */
    .form-section:last-of-type {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .form-section:hover {
      border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .section-title i {
      color: var(--primary-color);
      font-size: 1.75rem;
    }

    /* Form styling */
    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Ensure form rows align properly */
    .form-section .row {
      align-items: stretch;
      margin-left: -0.5rem;
      margin-right: -0.5rem;
    }

    .form-section .row > [class*="col-"] {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding-left: 0.5rem;
      padding-right: 0.5rem;
    }

    .form-section .form-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .form-label {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .form-label i {
      color: var(--primary-color);
      width: 16px;
    }

    .form-control {
      border: 2px solid #e5e7eb;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    }

    .form-control:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
      background: white;
    }

    .form-control::placeholder {
      color: #9ca3af;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .form-label-sm {
      display: block;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    .parity-selects {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      min-height: 80px;
    }

    .parity-selects .select-block {
      flex: 1 1 160px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .parity-selects .select-block label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary-color);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    .parity-selects .select-block select {
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35);
      height: 48px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
      transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }

    .parity-selects .select-block select:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
    }

    .parity-selects .parity-plus {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary-color);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.45);
      margin: auto 0;
    }

    .parity-helper {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    .form-text {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    /* Required field indicator */
    .required-field::after {
      content: " *";
      color: #dc2626;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* Checkbox and radio styling */
    .form-check {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .form-check-input {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      border: 2px solid #d1d5db;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .form-check-input:checked {
      background-color: var(--primary-color);
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    }

    .form-check-label {
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      margin-left: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .form-check-label:hover {
      color: var(--primary-color);
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 1rem;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      border: none;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--secondary-color));
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary-color), #047857);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-primary:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      border: 2px solid #d1d5db;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: transparent;
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.8);
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
      color: var(--primary-color);
    }

    /* Action buttons container */
    .action-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 2rem;
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    }

    /* Ensure buttons are aligned properly */
    .action-buttons .btn {
      min-width: 180px;
    }

    /* Loading animation */
    .loading {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border-top-color: white;
      animation: spin 1s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    /* Alert styling */
    .alert {
      border: none;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      border-left: 4px solid;
    }

    .alert-success {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
      color: #047857;
      border-left-color: var(--primary-color);
    }

    .alert-danger {
      background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1);
      color: #991b1b;
      border-left-color: #dc2626;
    }

    .alert-warning {
      background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1);
      color: #92400e;
      border-left-color: #f59e0b;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 2rem 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .footer p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Tablet and small laptop screens */
    @media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
      .main-container {
        padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      }

      .container {
        max-width: 100%;

      .form-section .row {

        margin-left: -0.75rem;

      }

      .form-section .row > [class*="col-"] {
        display: flex;

      .form-section .form-group {

      .section-title {

      .form-control {
        padding: 0.95rem 1.15rem;
        font-size: 0.98rem;
      }

      .parity-selects {
        padding: 1rem 1.25rem;

      }

      .parity-selects .select-block {
        flex: 1 1 150px;

      .header-section {
        padding: 1rem 0;

      .header-section h1 {
        font-size: 1.75rem;

      .header-section p {
        font-size: 1rem;

      .header-section .container {
        padding-left: 1.5rem;

      }

      .action-buttons {
        gap: 1.25rem;
      }

      .btn {
        padding: 1rem 2.25rem;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
      }
    }

    /* Large laptop and desktop screens */
    @media (min-width: 1025px) {
      .main-container {
        padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
      }

      .container {
        max-width: 1200px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding-left: 2rem;
        padding-right: 2rem;
      }

        max-width: 1100px;

      }

      .form-section {
        padding: 2.5rem 2.25rem;
        margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

      /* Optimal alignment for desktop form rows */
      .form-section .row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: stretch;
        margin-left: -1rem;
        margin-right: -1rem;
      }

      .form-section .row > [class*="col-"] {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;

      }

      .form-section .form-group {
        display: flex;

      .section-title {

      .parity-selects {
        padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;

      }

      .parity-selects .select-block {
        flex: 1 1 165px;
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .parity-selects .select-block label {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      }

      .parity-selects .select-block select {
        height: 52px;
        font-size: 1rem;
      }

      .header-section {
        padding: 1.25rem 0;
      }

      .header-section h1 {
        font-size: 2rem;

      .header-section p {
        font-size: 1.1rem;

      .header-section .container {
        padding-left: 2rem;

      .action-buttons {
        gap: 1.5rem;

      .form-label {

      }

      .parity-helper {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        margin-top: 0.875rem;
      }
    }

    /* Mobile responsiveness */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .main-container {
        padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
      }

      .form-container {
        padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
        margin: 1rem;
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

        padding: 1.5rem;
      }

      .header-section h1 {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      }

      .header-section .row {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }

      .header-section .col-md-4 {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
      }

      .header-section .d-flex {
        flex-wrap: wrap;

      }

      }

        order: 2;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }

        font-size: 1.25rem;
      }

      .form-control {
        padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;

        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      .header-section .d-flex {
        gap: 0.375rem !important;
      }

      .header-section .btn-sm {
        padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
      }

      .header-section .btn-secondary {
        padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
        font-size: 0.75rem;

        padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem !important;

        align-items: stretch;
        padding: 0.85rem;

      .parity-selects .parity-plus {
        width: 100%;
        height: 38px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;

        color: var(--primary-color);
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .parity-selects .select-block {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
      }

    /* High risk details toggle */
    #highRiskDetails {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.05);
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .status-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;

    .status-transferred { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: #2563eb; }

    .language-switcher {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .language-btn {
      padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .language-btn.active {
      background: var(--primary-color);
      color: white;
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
    }

    .language-btn:hover:not(.active) {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
    }

    .flag-icon {
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    /* Age Risk Alert */
    #ageRiskAlert {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1);
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    #ageRiskAlert.show {
      display: block;
    }

    #ageRiskAlert.hide {
      display: none;
    }

    /* Risk indicator on age input */
    .form-control.is-high-risk {
      border-color: #dc2626;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1);
    }

  // Preview function: Get the next ID without incrementing the counter
  async function previewNextPatientId(regionShortRaw, tspCodeRaw, facilityCodeRaw) {
    try {
      console.log('previewNextPatientId called with:', { regionShortRaw, tspCodeRaw, facilityCodeRaw });
      
      // Check if user is authenticated
      const user = firebase.auth().currentUser;
      if (!user) {
        throw new Error('User not authenticated');
      }
      
      const db = firebase.firestore();
      const regionShort = sanitizeCodeSegment(regionShortRaw, 'GEN');
      const tspCode = sanitizeCodeSegment(tspCodeRaw, 'UNK');
      // Sanitize facility code to ensure it's 3 digits
      let facilityCode = (facilityCodeRaw || '003').toString().trim().padStart(3, '0').substring(0, 3);
      if (!/^\d{3}$/.test(facilityCode)) {
        console.warn('Invalid facility code, defaulting to 003:', facilityCodeRaw);
        facilityCode = '003';
      }
      const yearSuffix = new Date().getFullYear().toString().slice(-2);
      // Counter ID now includes facility code: TSP_CODE_FACILITY_CODE_YEAR
      const sanitizedTspCode = tspCode.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '');
      const counterId = `${sanitizedTspCode}_${facilityCode}_${yearSuffix}`;
      const counterRef = db.collection('patient_counters').doc(counterId);
      
      console.log('Reading current serial for preview, counter ID:', counterId);
      
      // Read-only: Get current serial without incrementing
      const snapshot = await counterRef.get();
      let currentSerial = 0;
      if (snapshot.exists) {
        const data = snapshot.data();
        if (typeof data.lastSerial === 'number') {
          currentSerial = data.lastSerial;
          console.log('Current serial from counter:', currentSerial);
        }
      }
      
      // Calculate what the next ID would be (without actually incrementing)
      const nextSerial = currentSerial + 1;
      const serialStr = String(nextSerial).padStart(4, '0'); // Changed to 4 digits
      // New Patient ID format: TSP_CODE-FACILITY_CODE-YYNNNN
      const previewId = `${tspCode}-${facilityCode}-${yearSuffix}${serialStr}`;
      console.log('Preview ID calculated:', previewId);
      
      return {
        uniqueId: previewId,
        meta: {
          regionShort,
          tspCode,
          facilityCode,
          yearSuffix,
          serial: nextSerial
        }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error in previewNextPatientId:', error);
      throw new Error(`Failed to preview ID: ${error.message || error} (Code: ${error.code || 'unknown'})`);
    }
  }

    function evaluateAgeRisk() {
      const ageInput = document.getElementById('age');
      const ageRiskAlert = document.getElementById('ageRiskAlert');
      const ageValue = ageInput ? parseInt(ageInput.value, 10) : NaN;
      
      if (Number.isNaN(ageValue) || ageValue === 0) {

        return false;
      }
      
      const isHighRisk = ageValue < 17 || ageValue >= 40;

          ageRiskAlert.classList.add('show');

        } else {

          ageRiskAlert.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
      
      if (ageInput) {
        ageInput.classList.toggle('is-high-risk', isHighRisk);
      }

            console.warn('Error getting user role:', error);

          userId: currentUser ? currentUser.uid : null,
          township: userTownship,
          region: userRegion

              // Log the decision with justification

                await window.AuditLogger.logPatientOperation(
                  'duplicate_override',
                  null,
                  `User created new patient despite duplicates. Justification: ${justification}. Name: ${data.name}, phone: ${data.phone || 'N/A'}`
                );

      try {

        } else {
        const userDoc = await firebase.firestore().collection("users").doc(user.uid).get();

          const ud = userDoc.data();

          console.log('User township from Firestore:', ud.township);
        }
        userData = userDoc.exists ? userDoc.data() : {};
        }
        const userTownship = userData.township || "";
        const userRegion = userData.region || "";
        const userRole = userData.role || 'Midwife';
        const facilityCode = userData.facility_code || '003'; // Default to 003 (Other) if not set
        console.log('Township and region to assign to patient:', userTownship, userRegion);
        
        // Validate township (optional for Regional Officer - they use region)
        if (userRole !== 'Regional Officer' && (!userTownship || userTownship.trim() === '')) {

        if (userRole === 'Regional Officer' && !userRegion) {

            '<div class="alert alert-warning">⚠️ Warning: Your region is not set. Please contact an administrator.</div>';
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        
        data.township = userTownship;
        data.region = userRegion;
        
        console.log('Setting created_by field:', user.uid);
        console.log('Registration date:', data.registration_date);

        // Resolve location metadata and ensure hidden fields are populated
        let resolvedRegionShort = data.regionShort || '';
        let resolvedTspCode = data.tspCode || '';

        // Use pre-generated patient ID or generate if not present
        if (!data.patientUniqueId && patientUniqueIdHidden && patientUniqueIdHidden.value) {

            if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = data.patientUniqueId;
          } else {
          try {
            const idResult = await generatePatientUniqueId(resolvedRegionShort, resolvedTspCode, facilityCode);
            data.patientUniqueId = idResult.uniqueId;
            if (patientUniqueIdHidden) patientUniqueIdHidden.value = idResult.uniqueId;
            if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = idResult.uniqueId;
          } catch (idError) {
            console.error('Failed to generate patient unique ID:', idError);

          if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = data.patientUniqueId;
        }

        const gravidaValue = data.gravida_value ? parseInt(data.gravida_value, 10) : null;
        const parityPrimaryValue = data.parity_primary ? parseInt(data.parity_primary, 10) : null;
        const paritySecondaryValue = data.parity_secondary ? parseInt(data.parity_secondary, 10) : null;
        const youngestYearsRaw = data.youngestChildAgeYears !== undefined && data.youngestChildAgeYears !== '' ? parseInt(data.youngestChildAgeYears, 10) : null;
        const youngestMonthsRaw = data.youngestChildAgeMonths !== undefined && data.youngestChildAgeMonths !== '' ? parseInt(data.youngestChildAgeMonths, 10) : null;
        const youngestYears = Number.isFinite(youngestYearsRaw) ? Math.max(0, youngestYearsRaw) : null;
        const youngestMonths = Number.isFinite(youngestMonthsRaw) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(11, youngestMonthsRaw)) : null;
        const intervalMonths = (youngestYears === null && youngestMonths === null)
          ? null
          : (youngestYears || 0) * 12 + (youngestMonths || 0);
        const pregnancyWithin24 = data.pregnancyWithin24Months === 'true';

        const registrationDateDisplay = formatRegistrationDateDisplay(data.registration_date);
        
        // Convert field names to snake_case for consistency (no duplicates)
        const processedData = {

          age: parseInt(data.age),

          parity_primary: Number.isFinite(parityPrimaryValue) ? parityPrimaryValue : null,
          parity_secondary: Number.isFinite(paritySecondaryValue) ? paritySecondaryValue : null,
          
          // Maternal history
          youngest_child_age_years: youngestYears,
          youngest_child_age_months: youngestMonths,
          youngest_child_interval_months: intervalMonths,
          pregnancy_within_24_months: pregnancyWithin24,
          frequent_pregnancy: frequentPregnancy,
          age_risk: ageRisk,
          maternal_age_risk: ageRisk === 'Yes',
          
          // Location identifiers
          region_short_code: resolvedRegionShort || null,
          tsp_code: resolvedTspCode || null,
          patient_unique_id: data.patientUniqueId || null,
          
          // Contact info
          phone: data.phone || null,
          patient_address: data.patientAddress || null,
          emergency_contact: data.emergencyContact || null,
          emergency_phone: data.emergencyPhone || null,
          
          // Duplicate detection metadata
          duplicate_check_performed: true,
          duplicate_justification: sessionStorage.getItem('duplicateJustification') || null
        };
        
        // Clear duplicate check flag and justification from session storage
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('skipDuplicateCheck')) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('skipDuplicateCheck');
        }
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('duplicateJustification')) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('duplicateJustification');
        }
        
        console.log('Processed data to save:', processedData);
        console.log('created_by field in processed data:', processedData.created_by);
        
        // Log duplicate check result (no duplicates found)
        if (window.DuplicateDetector) {
          await window.DuplicateDetector.logCheck('checked', {
            name: processedData.name,
            age: processedData.age,
            phone: processedData.phone
          }, [], 'no_duplicates');
        }
        
        // Store patient data temporarily and redirect to consent screen
        const patientDataForConsent = {
          name: processedData.name,
          age: processedData.age,
          parity: processedData.parity,
          phone: processedData.phone || null,
          patient_address: processedData.patient_address || null,
          emergency_contact: processedData.emergency_contact || null,
          emergency_phone: processedData.emergency_phone || null,
          registration_date: processedData.registration_date || null,
          gravida: processedData.gravida || null,
          parity_primary: processedData.parity_primary || null,
          parity_secondary: processedData.parity_secondary || null,
          youngest_child_age_years: processedData.youngest_child_age_years || null,
          youngest_child_age_months: processedData.youngest_child_age_months || null,
          pregnancy_within_24_months: processedData.pregnancy_within_24_months || false,
          frequent_pregnancy: processedData.frequent_pregnancy || 'No',
          age_risk: processedData.age_risk || 'No',
          maternal_age_risk: processedData.maternal_age_risk || false,
          region_short_code: processedData.region_short_code || null,
          tsp_code: processedData.tsp_code || null,
          patient_unique_id: processedData.patient_unique_id || null,
          township: userTownship,
          region: userRegion,
          created_by: user.uid
        };

        // Save to sessionStorage for consent page
        sessionStorage.setItem('pendingPatientData', JSON.stringify(patientDataForConsent));

        // Redirect to consent page
        const consentUrl = 'patient-consent.html?data=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(patientDataForConsent));
        window.location.href = consentUrl;
        
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error adding document: ", error);
        
        // Reset button state on error
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
        }
        
        // Show error message
        messageDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>Error creating patient record: ${error.message}</div>`;
      }
      });

        setTimeout(async () => {
          updateParityField();
          toggleYoungestChildFields();
          evaluatePregnancyInterval();
          evaluateAgeRisk();
          updateRegistrationDatePreview();
          
          // Reload preview ID after reset (read-only, doesn't increment counter)
          if (patientUniqueIdHidden) patientUniqueIdHidden.value = '';
          
          // Get facility code from user document
          let facilityCode = '003'; // Default
          try {
            const user = firebase.auth().currentUser;
            if (user) {
              const userDoc = await firebase.firestore().collection("users").doc(user.uid).get();
              if (userDoc.exists) {
                const userData = userDoc.data();
                facilityCode = userData.facility_code || '003';
              }
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Failed to get facility code, using default:', error);
          }
          
          const regionShortInput = document.getElementById('regionShort');
          const tspCodeInput = document.getElementById('tspCode');
          const regionShort = regionShortInput ? regionShortInput.value : '';
          const tspCode = tspCodeInput ? tspCodeInput.value : '';
          
          if (patientUniqueIdDisplay && regionShort && tspCode && regionShort !== 'UNK' && tspCode !== 'UNK-0') {
            try {
              patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = 'Loading...';
              const previewResult = await previewNextPatientId(regionShort, tspCode, facilityCode);
              if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) {
                patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = previewResult.uniqueId;
                patientUniqueIdDisplay.placeholder = previewResult.uniqueId;
              }
            } catch (previewError) {
              console.warn('Failed to reload preview ID after reset:', previewError);
              if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) {
                patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = '';
                patientUniqueIdDisplay.placeholder = 'ID will be generated when you save';
              }
            }
          } else {
            if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) {
              patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = '';
              patientUniqueIdDisplay.placeholder = 'ID will be generated when you save';
            }
          }
        }, 0);
      });
      }, 100); // 100ms delay to ensure DOM is ready
    });

      form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      console.log('Form submit event triggered');
      e.preventDefault();

      const networkOffline = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !navigator.onLine;
      
      // Get button reference and show loading state
      let submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      
      // Fallback to alternative selectors if first one fails
      if (!submitBtn) {
        submitBtn = form.querySelector('.btn-primary');
      }
      
      // Last resort - search entire document
      if (!submitBtn) {
        submitBtn = document.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      }
      
      console.log('Form submission - Submit button found:', submitBtn);
      
      const messageDiv = document.getElementById('message');
      const originalText = submitBtn ? submitBtn.innerHTML : '';
      
      // Ensure parity hidden value is up to date before collecting data
      updateParityField();
      
      // Show loading state
      if (submitBtn) {
        submitBtn.innerHTML = '<div class="loading"></div> Registering Patient...';
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
      }
      
      // Clear previous messages
      messageDiv.textContent = '';
      messageDiv.className = '';
      
      const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
      
      // Basic form validation
      if (!data.name || !data.age || !data.registration_date) {
        messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>Please fill in all required fields (Name, Age, Registration Date).</div>';
        // Reset button state on validation error
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
        }
        return;
      }
      
      // OFFLINE MODE: Save to IndexedDB and skip Firestore entirely
      if (window.OfflineManager && (window.OfflineManager.isOfflineMode() || networkOffline)) {
        try {
          let profile = await window.OfflineManager.getCachedUserProfile();
          if (!profile) {
            const authUser = firebase.auth().currentUser;
            const uid = (authUser && authUser.uid) || localStorage.getItem('uid') || '';
            profile = {
              uid: uid,
              township: localStorage.getItem('userTownship') || '',
              region: localStorage.getItem('userRegion') || '',
              facility_code: localStorage.getItem('facilityCode') || '003'
            };
          }
          if (!profile || !profile.uid) {
            messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>Cannot identify logged-in user for offline save. Please login again.</div>';
            if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText; submitBtn.disabled = false; }
            return;
          }

          const tempId = window.OfflineManager.generateLocalId();
          const locationMeta = getLocationMetadataByTownship(profile.township);
          const regionShort = (locationMeta && locationMeta.regionShort) || 'UNK';
          const tspCode = (locationMeta && locationMeta.tspCode) || 'UNK';

          const gravidaVal = data.gravida_value ? parseInt(data.gravida_value, 10) : null;
          const parityPrimVal = data.parity_primary ? parseInt(data.parity_primary, 10) : null;
          const paritySecVal = data.parity_secondary ? parseInt(data.parity_secondary, 10) : null;
          const ageVal = parseInt(data.age, 10);
          const ageRisk = (Number.isFinite(ageVal) && (ageVal < 17 || ageVal >= 40)) ? 'Yes' : 'No';

          const offlinePatient = {
            localId: tempId,
            _isOffline: true,
            _needsOfficialPatientId: true,
            name: data.name,
            age: parseInt(data.age),
            township: profile.township,
            region: profile.region,
            created_by: profile.uid,
            status: 'registered',
            parity: data.parity || '',
            registration_date: data.registration_date || null,
            gravida: Number.isFinite(gravidaVal) ? gravidaVal : null,
            parity_primary: Number.isFinite(parityPrimVal) ? parityPrimVal : null,
            parity_secondary: Number.isFinite(paritySecVal) ? paritySecVal : null,
            age_risk: ageRisk,
            maternal_age_risk: ageRisk === 'Yes',
            region_short_code: regionShort,
            tsp_code: tspCode,
            facility_code: profile.facility_code || '003',
            patient_unique_id: null,
            syncState: 'pending',
            phone: data.phone || null,
            patient_address: data.patientAddress || null,
            emergency_contact: data.emergencyContact || null,
            emergency_phone: data.emergencyPhone || null,
            hasConsent: true,
            consentStatus: 'consented'
          };

          await window.OfflineManager.saveOfflineRecord('pending_patients', offlinePatient);

          // Set sessionStorage so patient-care-hub can load this offline patient
          const offlinePatientForSession = { id: tempId, ...offlinePatient };
          sessionStorage.setItem('selectedPatientId', tempId);
          sessionStorage.setItem('selectedPatientData', JSON.stringify(offlinePatientForSession));

          // Ask midwife: continue to care or register another?
          const goToCare = window.AppDialog && AppDialog.confirm
            ? await AppDialog.confirm(
                `Patient "${data.name}" saved locally. Sync later.\n\nWould you like to continue providing care for this patient?\n\n(OK = Go to Care Hub, Cancel = Register another patient)`,
                { title: 'Patient Saved Offline' }

            : false;

          if (goToCare) {
            messageDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-success"><i class="fas fa-check-circle me-2"></i><strong>Saved successfully locally!</strong> Do not forget to sync later when you are online.</div>`;
            setTimeout(() => {
              window.location.href = 'patient-care-hub.html';
            }, 1200);
          } else {
            messageDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-success"><i class="fas fa-check-circle me-2"></i><strong>Saved locally, sync later.</strong> Patient "<strong>${data.name}</strong>" is available on this device.</div>`;
            if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText; submitBtn.disabled = false; }
            form.reset();
          }
          return;
        } catch (offlineErr) {
          console.error('Offline save error:', offlineErr);
          messageDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>Error saving offline: ${offlineErr.message}</div>`;
          if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText; submitBtn.disabled = false; }
          return;
        }
      }

      // STEP 1: Check for duplicate patients (skip when no network — duplicate check needs server)
      if (!window.DuplicateDetector) {
        console.error('❌ DuplicateDetector not loaded! Check if js/duplicate-detector.js is included.');
      }
      
      if (window.DuplicateDetector && !networkOffline) {
        console.log('🔍 Checking for duplicate patients...');
        
        // Get current user info for role-based filtering
        const currentUser = firebase.auth().currentUser;
        let userRole = 'Midwife'; // Default
        let userTownship = null;
        let userRegion = null;
        
        if (currentUser) {
          try {
            const userDoc = await firebase.firestore().collection('users').doc(currentUser.uid).get();
            if (userDoc.exists) {
              const userData = userDoc.data();
              userRole = userData.role || 'Midwife';
              userTownship = userData.township || null;
              userRegion = userData.region || null;
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Error getting user role:', error);
          }
        }
        
        const duplicateCheck = await window.DuplicateDetector.check({
          name: data.name,
          age: parseInt(data.age),
          phone: data.phone || data.phoneNumber
        }, {
          userRole: userRole,
          userId: currentUser ? currentUser.uid : null,
          township: userTownship,
          region: userRegion
        });
        
        if (duplicateCheck.hasDuplicates) {
          console.log('⚠️ Duplicate patients found:', duplicateCheck.duplicates);
          
          // Show duplicate warning modal
          window.DuplicateDetector.showWarning(
            duplicateCheck.duplicates,
            // onLink callback - user wants to use existing patient
            async (existingPatientId) => {
              console.log('User chose to link to existing patient:', existingPatientId);
              
              // Log the decision
              if (window.AuditLogger) {
                await window.AuditLogger.logPatientOperation(
                  'duplicate_linked',
                  existingPatientId,
                  `User chose to link to existing patient instead of creating new record. Original name: ${data.name}, phone: ${data.phone || 'N/A'}`
                );
              }
              
              // Redirect to patient care hub with existing patient
              sessionStorage.setItem('selectedPatientId', existingPatientId);
              window.location.href = 'patient-care-hub.html';
            },
            // onContinue callback - user wants to create new patient
            async (justification) => {
              console.log('User chose to create new patient with justification:', justification);
              
              // Log the decision with justification
              if (window.AuditLogger) {
                await window.AuditLogger.logPatientOperation(
                  'duplicate_override',
                  null,
                  `User created new patient despite duplicates. Justification: ${justification}. Name: ${data.name}, phone: ${data.phone || 'N/A'}`
                );
              }
              
              // Store justification in patient data
              data.duplicateOverrideJustification = justification;
              
              // Continue with patient creation (will be called again below)
              // We'll set a flag to skip duplicate check
              data.skipDuplicateCheck = true;
              
              // Trigger form submission again
              form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
            }
          );
          
          // Reset button and return (wait for user decision)
          if (submitBtn) {
            submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
          }
          return;
        } else {
          console.log('✅ No duplicates found');
        }
      }
      
      try {
        const user = firebase.auth().currentUser;
        console.log('Current user object:', user);
        console.log('Current user UID:', user?.uid);
        
        if (!user) {
          console.error('❌ No authenticated user found!');
          document.getElementById("message").innerHTML = 
            '<div class="alert alert-danger">❌ Error: You must be logged in to register patients.</div>';
          
          // Reset button state
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        
        let userData = {};
        if (networkOffline) {
          if (typeof UserCache !== 'undefined') {
            userData = UserCache.getCached(user.uid);

              try {
                userData = await UserCache.get(user.uid);
              } catch (err) {
                userData = null;
              }
            }
          }
          if (!userData) {
            document.getElementById("message").innerHTML =
              '<div class="alert alert-warning"><i class="fas fa-wifi me-2"></i>Connect online once so your profile loads on this device. Then you can register patients while offline.</div>';
            submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
            return;
          }
        } else {
        const userDoc = await firebase.firestore().collection("users").doc(user.uid).get();
        console.log('User document exists:', userDoc.exists);
        if (userDoc.exists) {
          const ud = userDoc.data();
          console.log('User data:', ud);
          console.log('User township from Firestore:', ud.township);
        }
        userData = userDoc.exists ? userDoc.data() : {};
        }
        const userTownship = userData.township || "";
        const userRegion = userData.region || "";
        const userRole = userData.role || 'Midwife';
        const facilityCode = userData.facility_code || '003'; // Default to 003 (Other) if not set
        console.log('Township and region to assign to patient:', userTownship, userRegion);
        
        // Validate township (optional for Regional Officer - they use region)
        if (userRole !== 'Regional Officer' && (!userTownship || userTownship.trim() === '')) {
          console.error('User township is empty or invalid:', userTownship);
          document.getElementById("message").innerHTML = 
            '<div class="alert alert-warning">⚠️ Warning: Your township is not set. Please contact an administrator to set your township.</div>';
          
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        if (userRole === 'Regional Officer' && !userRegion) {
          console.error('Regional Officer missing region');
          document.getElementById("message").innerHTML = 
            '<div class="alert alert-warning">⚠️ Warning: Your region is not set. Please contact an administrator.</div>';
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        
        data.township = userTownship;
        data.region = userRegion;
        
        console.log('Setting created_by field:', user.uid);
        console.log('Registration date:', data.registration_date);

        // Resolve location metadata and ensure hidden fields are populated
        let resolvedRegionShort = data.regionShort || '';
        let resolvedTspCode = data.tspCode || '';
        const locationMetadata = getLocationMetadataByTownship(userTownship);
        if ((!resolvedRegionShort || !resolvedTspCode) && locationMetadata) {
          resolvedRegionShort = locationMetadata.regionShort || resolvedRegionShort;
          resolvedTspCode = locationMetadata.tspCode || resolvedTspCode;
        }
        if (regionShortInputHidden) regionShortInputHidden.value = resolvedRegionShort || '';
        if (tspCodeInputHidden) tspCodeInputHidden.value = resolvedTspCode || '';

        // Use pre-generated patient ID or generate if not present
        if (!data.patientUniqueId && patientUniqueIdHidden && patientUniqueIdHidden.value) {
          data.patientUniqueId = patientUniqueIdHidden.value;
        }
        if (!data.patientUniqueId) {
          if (networkOffline) {
            data.patientUniqueId = `GEN-${Date.now()}`;
            if (patientUniqueIdHidden) patientUniqueIdHidden.value = data.patientUniqueId;
            if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = data.patientUniqueId;
          } else {
          try {
            const idResult = await generatePatientUniqueId(resolvedRegionShort, resolvedTspCode, facilityCode);
            data.patientUniqueId = idResult.uniqueId;
            if (patientUniqueIdHidden) patientUniqueIdHidden.value = idResult.uniqueId;
            if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = idResult.uniqueId;
          } catch (idError) {
            console.error('Failed to generate patient unique ID:', idError);
            data.patientUniqueId = data.patientUniqueId || `GEN-${Date.now()}`;
          }
          }
        } else {
          if (patientUniqueIdHidden) patientUniqueIdHidden.value = data.patientUniqueId;
          if (patientUniqueIdDisplay) patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = data.patientUniqueId;
        }

        const gravidaValue = data.gravida_value ? parseInt(data.gravida_value, 10) : null;
        const parityPrimaryValue = data.parity_primary ? parseInt(data.parity_primary, 10) : null;
        const paritySecondaryValue = data.parity_secondary ? parseInt(data.parity_secondary, 10) : null;
        const youngestYearsRaw = data.youngestChildAgeYears !== undefined && data.youngestChildAgeYears !== '' ? parseInt(data.youngestChildAgeYears, 10) : null;
        const youngestMonthsRaw = data.youngestChildAgeMonths !== undefined && data.youngestChildAgeMonths !== '' ? parseInt(data.youngestChildAgeMonths, 10) : null;
        const youngestYears = Number.isFinite(youngestYearsRaw) ? Math.max(0, youngestYearsRaw) : null;
        const youngestMonths = Number.isFinite(youngestMonthsRaw) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(11, youngestMonthsRaw)) : null;
        const intervalMonths = (youngestYears === null && youngestMonths === null)
          ? null
          : (youngestYears || 0) * 12 + (youngestMonths || 0);
        const pregnancyWithin24 = data.pregnancyWithin24Months === 'true';
        const frequentPregnancy = pregnancyWithin24 ? 'Yes' : 'No';
        const ageValue = parseInt(data.age, 10);
        const ageRisk = (Number.isFinite(ageValue) && (ageValue < 17 || ageValue >= 40)) ? 'Yes' : 'No';
        const registrationDateDisplay = formatRegistrationDateDisplay(data.registration_date);
        
        // Convert field names to snake_case for consistency (no duplicates)
        const processedData = {
          name: data.name,
          age: parseInt(data.age),
          township: data.township,

          created_at: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          created_by: user.uid,
          status: 'registered', // NEW: Initial status is "Registered"
          
          // Basic info
          parity: data.parity || '',
          registration_date: data.registration_date || null,
          registration_date_display: registrationDateDisplay || null,
          gravida: Number.isFinite(gravidaValue) ? gravidaValue : null,
          parity_primary: Number.isFinite(parityPrimaryValue) ? parityPrimaryValue : null,
          parity_secondary: Number.isFinite(paritySecondaryValue) ? paritySecondaryValue : null,
          
          // Maternal history
          youngest_child_age_years: youngestYears,
          youngest_child_age_months: youngestMonths,
          youngest_child_interval_months: intervalMonths,
          pregnancy_within_24_months: pregnancyWithin24,
          frequent_pregnancy: frequentPregnancy,
          age_risk: ageRisk,
          maternal_age_risk: ageRisk === 'Yes',
          
          // Location identifiers
          region_short_code: resolvedRegionShort || null,
          tsp_code: resolvedTspCode || null,
          patient_unique_id: data.patientUniqueId || null,
          
          // Contact info
          phone: data.phone || null,
          patient_address: data.patientAddress || null,
          emergency_contact: data.emergencyContact || null,
          emergency_phone: data.emergencyPhone || null,
          
          // Duplicate detection metadata
          duplicate_check_performed: true,
          duplicate_justification: sessionStorage.getItem('duplicateJustification') || null
        };
        
        // Clear duplicate check flag and justification from session storage
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('skipDuplicateCheck')) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('skipDuplicateCheck');
        }
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('duplicateJustification')) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('duplicateJustification');
        }
        
        console.log('Processed data to save:', processedData);
        console.log('created_by field in processed data:', processedData.created_by);
        
        // Log duplicate check result (no duplicates found)
        if (window.DuplicateDetector) {
          await window.DuplicateDetector.logCheck('checked', {
            name: processedData.name,
            age: processedData.age,
            phone: processedData.phone
          }, [], 'no_duplicates');
        }
        
        // Store patient data temporarily and redirect to consent screen
        const patientDataForConsent = {
          name: processedData.name,
          age: processedData.age,
          parity: processedData.parity,
          phone: processedData.phone || null,
          patient_address: processedData.patient_address || null,
          emergency_contact: processedData.emergency_contact || null,
          emergency_phone: processedData.emergency_phone || null,
          registration_date: processedData.registration_date || null,
          gravida: processedData.gravida || null,
          parity_primary: processedData.parity_primary || null,
          parity_secondary: processedData.parity_secondary || null,
          youngest_child_age_years: processedData.youngest_child_age_years || null,
          youngest_child_age_months: processedData.youngest_child_age_months || null,
          pregnancy_within_24_months: processedData.pregnancy_within_24_months || false,
          frequent_pregnancy: processedData.frequent_pregnancy || 'No',
          age_risk: processedData.age_risk || 'No',
          maternal_age_risk: processedData.maternal_age_risk || false,
          region_short_code: processedData.region_short_code || null,
          tsp_code: processedData.tsp_code || null,
          patient_unique_id: processedData.patient_unique_id || null,
          township: userTownship,
          region: userRegion,
          created_by: user.uid
        };

        // Save to sessionStorage for consent page
        sessionStorage.setItem('pendingPatientData', JSON.stringify(patientDataForConsent));

        // Redirect to consent page
        const consentUrl = 'patient-consent.html?data=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(patientDataForConsent));
        window.location.href = consentUrl;
        
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error adding document: ", error);
        
        // Reset button state on error
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
        }
        
        // Show error message
        messageDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>Error creating patient record: ${error.message}</div>`;
      }
      });

      form.addEventListener('reset', async () => {
        setTimeout(async () => {
          updateParityField();
          toggleYoungestChildFields();
          evaluatePregnancyInterval();
          evaluateAgeRisk();
          updateRegistrationDatePreview();
          
          // Reload preview ID after reset (read-only, doesn't increment counter)
          if (patientUniqueIdHidden) patientUniqueIdHidden.value = '';
          
          // Get facility code from user document
          let facilityCode = '003'; // Default
          try {
            const user = firebase.auth().currentUser;

                facilityCode = userData.facility_code || '003';
              }

            console.warn('Failed to get facility code, using default:', error);

          const tspCodeInput = document.getElementById('tspCode');

          if (patientUniqueIdDisplay && regionShort && tspCode && regionShort !== 'UNK' && tspCode !== 'UNK-0') {
            try {
              patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = 'Loading...';
              const previewResult = await previewNextPatientId(regionShort, tspCode, facilityCode);

                patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = previewResult.uniqueId;
                patientUniqueIdDisplay.placeholder = previewResult.uniqueId;
              }

              patientUniqueIdDisplay.value = '';
              patientUniqueIdDisplay.placeholder = 'ID will be generated when you save';
            }
          }
        }, 0);
      });
      }, 100); // 100ms delay to ensure DOM is ready
    });

    };
